name: unpivot
description: Melts row objects into long format: for each input row, one output row per melted column, carrying idColumns plus [nameInto] (column name, default "column") and [valueInto] (cell value, default "value"). Absent keys are skipped; explicit null values are kept. When columns is omitted, each row melts its own keys minus idColumns (per-row melt); when given (transformer resolving to a list of strings, e.g. returnValue wrapping a literal), only those columns are melted. nameInto/valueInto colliding with idColumns is a handler error. Issue #265.

applyTo.description: The list of row objects to melt. The actual type is set by the platform depending on interpolation for the transformer. In SQL mode, must be a constant/returnValue/getFromContext/getFromParameters (the sqlStringForApplyTo allowlist).

idColumns.description: Attributes carried unchanged into every output row (e.g. ["user"]).

columns.description: Explicit whitelist of columns to melt: a transformer resolving to a list of strings (e.g. returnValue wrapping a literal list). A bare string array is NOT schema-expressible here (ambiguous with the transformer array branch for jzodTypeCheck). When omitted, each row melts its own keys minus idColumns (per-row melt).

nameInto.description: Output attribute receiving the melted column name. Defaults to "column". Must not collide with idColumns.

valueInto.description: Output attribute receiving the melted cell value. Defaults to "value". Must not collide with idColumns.
